notes.title: Level editor coming soon!
notes.content:
Heya pixels! 

It's been a while since our last post. But no worries, we are not glitched!
Currently we are working on a huge update with number one goal BRAND NEW Level editor with steam workshop integration so you will be able to create your own levels or play levels made by our awesome community! =)

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/608986557407559719/936072369183805460/LevelEdtiro.gif?width=728&height=410

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/608986557407559719/942141531593265172/updatekLevlEdtiorerk.gif

So what features will the level editor have?
[olist]
Level Length
Level Speed
Backgrounds
Music
Coins, coins and coins
All enemy types
and more!
[/olist]

In case you would like to stay even more updated, you are always welcome on our discord community! ːhappy_creepː

notes.title: Released!!!
notes.content:
Heya Pixels!


Are you ready? Over than 14 unique levels each with new design, music and mechanics, waits for you just only for 9.99 $ with 10% OFF SALE. 

Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Release date delayed
notes.content:
Heya pixels!

We are doing our best to create something that was not there before. We have decided to redesign a huge part of the game and this decision requires more time, so we are both sad and happy to announce the game release date delayed to make the game even better. 

So, what should you expect?
[olist]
 Better Design
 HQ Textures
 New Trailer
 Better Effects
[/olist]

When? 20-29. January ~ 2021 ːhappy_creepː
